properties.description: At every eligible observation, occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue count, with synchronous reset and pre-edge acceptance including full/empty simultaneous transfers.
Full is asserted exactly when the independently modeled queue contains sixteen words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independently modeled queue contains no words.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals its oldest accepted word, checking ordering, wraparound, rejected writes, simultaneous transfers, and reset recovery. Empty data is not checked.
Public status is known and self-consistent: fill is at most sixteen, full corresponds to fill sixteen, and empty corresponds to fill zero.
After a synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is deasserted, and empty is asserted; this also checks pre-edge observations following reset.
